review: A tank with Rupture application. Her way of tanking is by making use of the self sustain she gets from hitting enemies who are trying to attack her in the Chaining Phase, This makes her very strong in focused fight but inconsistent in non-focused fight. Surprisingly she is either count positive or neutral unless S3 rerolls, If you have no Rupture Count her S2 inflicts 4 Count although if you already have Rupture Count you may wanna get atleast 4 Rupture Count as her Rupture Count application is on the last coin. Other than that she has average clashing power with conditions fulfilled Notable E.G.O. Synergies
